title: Build operational CPT Manager admin
description: Replace the CPT Manager backlog view with a real WordPress admin tool for compact content models.
objective: Let implementers create, edit, and delete custom post type definitions, taxonomies, and typed meta fields from the WordPress backend.
expected_outputs: Content Models list with create/edit/delete actions.
Operational CPT form with identity, visibility, supports, taxonomies, and meta fields.
State-changing actions protected by capability checks and nonces.
Saved definitions remain compatible with CptManager::register_definitions().
acceptance_criteria: A CPT definition can be saved through the admin form and appears in CptManager::all().
Taxonomy and meta field rows are normalized through existing CptManager sanitizers.
Deleting a definition requires a nonce and manage_options capability.
The implementation does not alter existing posts, terms, or post meta.
verification: Run PHP lint on changed admin and CPT files.
Run WP-CLI smoke to render list and edit states.
Run WP-CLI save/delete smoke against CptManager data shape if practical.
TASK-013 validated successfully with MCP validate_task.
PHP lint passed for changed admin/support files through Docker WP-CLI runtime.
WP-CLI render smoke returned cpts:rendered:clean-copy:no-nonce and cpts_new:rendered:clean-copy:nonce.
WP-CLI option contract smoke returned cpt_save:ok.
Playwright captured content-models.png and content-model-form.png with no page-level horizontal overflow.

budgets.context_budget: CptManager storage contract and WordPress registration hooks
budgets.scope_budget: admin CRUD for existing CPT contract only
budgets.validation_budget: lint, render smoke, option shape smoke

risks: Changing stored CPT slugs can affect rewrite behavior; the form should preserve explicit slug fields.
Flush rewrite calls already exist in CptManager save/delete and should not be broadened.
